calculation.description: Fade each asset's completed three-session return. Scale the reversal by the trailing 60-session percentile rank of recent cross-sectional return dispersion: stronger reversal exposure in high-dispersion conditions and half-strength at the lowest dispersion. All inputs are lag-safe completed daily bars; the cross-sectional dispersion is common across assets on each date. Signals are ranked cross-sectionally for portfolio use.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2021, 2023, 2025 and 2026, negative in 2022 and slightly negative in 2020/2024. Recent daily results remained positive: 2024-01 onward IC 0.05187/ICIR 0.14699 (222 dates), 2025-01 onward IC 0.07046/ICIR 0.20261 (173 dates), and 2026-01 onward IC 0.03459/ICIR 0.10137 (124 dates). Small 15-asset cross-section requires conservative uncertainty interpretation.
